releases.notes:
# Simply Airdrops v2.1.0

A major configuration and QoL update focused on giving server owners more control over airdrops.

## Added
### Spawn Control
- Minimum & maximum player spawn distance
- Spawn radius control
- Biome & dimension blacklist
- Ocean spawn blacklist toggle

### Item Settings
- Radio & Flare durability
- Radio & Flare cooldowns
- Custom smoke colors

### Server QoL
- Crate despawn timer
- Custom announcement messages
- Custom warning & location messages
- Toggle coordinate display
- Custom Radio & Flare use messages

### Optional Mob Guards
- Configurable vanilla & modded mob defenders
- Custom mob list, count & spawn radius
- Disabled by default
- Safe server-side entity validation

### In-Game Config GUI
- Cloth Config support
- Mods menu config button
- Organized categories with tooltips
- Live in-game config editing

## Improvements
- Better config validation
- Improved dedicated server compatibility
- Config values now properly affect gameplay
- General code cleanup and stability improvements

## Fixes
- Fixed Medical Crate loot.
- Fixed several loot tables that could not be edited through JSON configs.

releases.notes:
# Simply Airdrops 2.0.0 - NeoForge 1.21.1

## Highlights
- Added a full NeoForge 1.21.1 port of Simply Airdrops.
- Added the flare gun as an immersive way to call airdrops.
- Added configurable airdrop spawn height, fall speed, radio consumption, and radio controller craftability.
- Added airplane sounds for radio, flare gun, and timed airdrops.

## Gameplay
- Flare gun can call an airdrop, plays launch effects, creates a flare/firework particle burst, and has durability.
- Flare gun can appear in Pillager Outposts, Desert Pyramids, and Shipwreck Supply Chests.
- Timed airdrops now announce the drop location and play airplane audio when spawned.
- Red airdrop particle stream is longer and more visible.

## Loot And Crates
- Fixed generated crate items not carrying their saved loot correctly on NeoForge 1.21.1.
- Fixed crate placement so filled crate items load their stored loot into the placed crate block entity.
- Fixed medic crate potions using old NBT by converting them to 1.21.1 potion components.
- Filtered known buggy TacZ attachment loot entries to reduce broken weapon crate drops.

## Compatibility And Porting
- Migrated mod metadata, registries, loot modifiers, recipe conditions, config screen, block entities, and GeckoLib usage to NeoForge 1.21.1.
- Updated global loot modifiers from Forge data paths to NeoForge data paths.
- Kept 2D inventory icons for crates while retaining in-world GeckoLib crate models.

## Build
- Minecraft: 1.21.1
- Loader: NeoForge 21.1.233
- Mod version: 2.0.0

# Simply Airdrops 2.0.0

This update focuses on bug fixes, improved compatibility, customization options, and a new immersive way to call in airdrops.

## Added
- Added a new Flare Gun item for calling airdrops.
- Added flare-launching visual effects, including red trail particles, smoke effects, and a firework-style burst.
- Added airplane sound effects when using the Flare Gun.
- Added Flare Gun loot spawns to Pillager Outposts, Desert Pyramids, and Shipwreck Supply Chests.
- Added a configurable airdrop spawn height option.
- Added configuration options for Radio Controller consumption and craftability.
- Added new 2D inventory icons for crate items.

## Changed
- Airdrops no longer spawn at a hardcoded Y=400 by default.
- The Radio Controller recipe is now properly displayed in JEI when crafting is enabled.
- Improved airdrop visibility by extending the red particle trail.
- Updated crate inventory icons with clearer 2D sprites.

## Fixed
- Fixed airdrops getting stuck in the sky when using optimization and entity-culling mods.
- Fixed broken TacZ attachment loot appearing in weapon crates.
- Fixed the Radio Controller recipe not appearing in JEI.
- Fixed several minor loot table and compatibility issues.
